Today on the show: 

We grow more persuaded that Charlie’s mic was rigged. 

-We discover something most curious about the individual who last mic’d Charlie Kirk. And it’s really, really, inexplicably weird. 
-Why I don’t believe the necklace theory holds any weight.
-Another Frank Turek discrepancy.

posts.text:
Via FOIA, we formally requested Kash Patel’s travel itinerary for the 3 days leading up to Charlie Kirk’s assassination and we just heard back and were told the burden of the request is too great. 

How is this even remotely legal?
